request.description: Replaces the update channels (all three fields required). Optional `If-Match: "<version>"` from the last read. Channels for case and work updates (application status, analysis results, document requests, lead offers, payouts). Security and consent messages (sign-in and consent codes, invitations, consent links) are always sent. At least one of SMS, email or push stays on. WhatsApp and marketing opt-ins are consents: use `POST /me/consents` and `POST /me/consents/:purpose/withdraw`.
